real: I think a call to those skills should trigger installation
prev_agent: Fixed. The `summarize` skill now has `requires: bins: [summarize]`. The underlying behavior here is working as designed — all three systems (Hermes, OpenClaw, Moltis) list all skills in the prompt and let the agent try them. Skills with `requires:` that aren't met show as ineligible in the web UI with install instructions. A follow-up improvement could be annotating ineligible skills in the system prompt itself (e.g., `<skill name="summarize" eligible="false">`) so the agent knows before trying.
